== Notes == 
* The amount of energy lost as the caster of Ether Lord can be lowered through [[energy hiding]], but not the amount of energy lost by the energy degeneration.
* Consider using before [[Ether Signet]].
* Consider using just before [[Ether Prodigy]] ends- this way you will take minimal/no damage.
